title: Approximate Message Passing with Random Initialization for Phase Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2608.01654v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Randomly initialized first-order iterative algorithms are simple, widely used, and empirically effective across many high-dimensional inference problems, yet their theoretical behavior remains far less understood than that of algorithms started from more elaborate, problem-specific initializations such as spectral initialization. This paper takes a step toward closing this gap by studying randomly initialized approximate message passing (AMP) for noiseless phase retrieval, a canonical nonconvex inference problem. We give a non-asymptotic, growing-horizon characterization of the AMP trajectory from random initialization, and show that it achieves both the information-theoretic weak recovery threshold $\delta_{\rm weak}=1/2$ and the AMP strong recovery threshold $\delta_{\rm str}\approx1.13$, matching the recovery thresholds established for spectrally initialized AMP. translated_title: 面向相位恢复的随机初始化近似消息传递算法
translated_abstract: 随机初始化的一阶迭代算法简单、应用广泛，并在许多高维推断问题中被证明经验上有效，但与那些从更精细的、针对特定问题的初始化（如谱初始化）出发的算法相比，其理论行为仍然远未得到充分理解。本文通过研究针对无噪声相位恢复（一个典型的非凸推断问题）的随机初始化近似消息传递（AMP）算法，为缩小这一差距迈出了一步。我们给出了从随机初始化出发的AMP轨迹的非渐近、增长视野刻画，并证明它同时达到了信息论的弱恢复阈值 δ_weak=1/2 和 AMP 的强恢复阈值 δ_str≈1.13，与已针对谱初始化AMP所建立的恢复阈值相匹配。关键的技术要素有两方面：（i）一个非渐近……
tldr: 本文对随机初始化的近似消息传递（AMP）算法在无噪声相位恢复中的轨迹给出了非渐近刻画，证明其可同时达到信息论弱恢复阈值和强恢复阈值，性能与谱初始化AMP相当。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a non-asymptotic characterization of randomly initialized approximate message passing (AMP) for noiseless phase retrieval, proving that it achieves both the information-theoretic weak recovery threshold and the AMP strong recovery threshold, matching the performance of spectrally initialized AMP.
